A fix for frame drops while a game is in front on Windows.

## Fixed

- On Windows, the stream should no longer stutter or stop for a few seconds when a game (or anything else) is focused instead of Telescope. Windows slowed Telescope down in the background, and decoding on the graphics card got stuck behind the game.
- If decoding on the graphics card still can't keep up, the processor takes over for a few minutes and then the card gets another try. Settings says the card was too slow instead of saying it failed.
- A short hiccup on the computer no longer makes Dynamic drop the phone's bitrate to the lowest it goes, so the picture doesn't go blurry for a while after it.

## Changed

- Copy diagnostics now shows more about what was going on when frames dropped, like how long each step took, the worst moments and a timeline. The privacy filtering got better too.
